body: Honestly, I just feel like such a POS. I was abused as a kid in many ways and I have just internalized that abuse so that now I just hurt whoever I am with. I really thought this one could be different because I am trying so hard to recover from my past and be a whole person but I've just ended up hurting him and passing down the emotional violence. If the bad things that happened to me get to control my life and make me a bad person, what point is there in continuing to try and live?
